strings.travel/AboutPage.text15: Founder & Travel Advisor · Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe
strings.travel/AboutPage.text18: I’m Fungai Mtetwa, the travel advisor behind Outbound Holidays. Victoria Falls is home, and I’ve spent more than nine years working in tourism here.
strings.travel/AboutPage.text19: I know how exciting planning a trip here can be. I also know how quickly it can become confusing when you start comparing accommodation, activities, transfers, prices and different recommendations online.
strings.travel/AboutPage.text20: My job is to make those decisions easier. I personally help you understand your options and put together a holiday that suits your budget, interests, pace and the people you’re travelling with.
strings.travel/AboutPage.text21: That starts with listening. A family holiday, a couple’s getaway and a first safari need different things, and I want to understand yours before recommending anything.
strings.travel/AboutPage.text23: Travellers rarely struggle because there is too little information about Victoria Falls. Often, there is too much. You can find plenty of hotels, activities, packages and opinions, but knowing which ones make sense for your own trip is harder.
strings.travel/AboutPage.text24: Which accommodation suits your budget and the way you want to travel? What should you prioritise in a short stay? How much can you comfortably fit in, and what can you skip?
strings.travel/AboutPage.text25: I started Outbound Holidays to help bridge that gap. I bring local knowledge and personal guidance to those choices, then help accommodation, activities and transfers fit together without rushing your holiday or spending unnecessarily.

strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text1: What time does The Boma start and end?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text2: The Boma evening begins at 6:45 PM with a ceremonial traditional welcome, hand washing, and village beer tasting. The interactive drumming show reaches its crescendo around 8:45 PM, followed by table acapella serenades and desserts. The evening concludes between 9:45 PM and 10:00 PM.
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text3: Is hotel transfer included in the experience?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text4: Round-trip hotel transfers are optional and can be easily bundled with your reservation. Our air-conditioned vehicles pick you up directly from your Victoria Falls hotel or safari lodge around 6:15 PM and return you safely after the show.
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text5: What food is served at the African buffet?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text6: The evening begins with a waiter-served starter platter including smoked crocodile tail, salted groundnuts with 'Nyimo' round nuts, and corn fritters. The main buffet features an open-fire braai with grilled game meats, beef, pork, chicken, and daily spit roast, plus traditional 'Umzingeli' hunter's potjie stews, Zambezi bream, Kapenta whitebait, peanut butter rice, and authentic sadza (isitshwala).
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text7: Are vegetarian and vegan options available?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text8: Yes! The Boma caters generously to vegetarian and plant-based diners with dedicated cooking stations preparing daily chef's pasta, vegetable stir-fries, bush vegetables, fresh soups, oven-baked garlic bread, and an extensive fresh salad bar including three-bean salad, sweet potato salad, potato salad, and beetroot salad.
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text9: Is The Boma family-friendly for children?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text10: Extremely family-friendly! Children of all ages love the vibrant energy, face painting, interactive drumming session where every guest gets their own Djembe drum, and the fun 'mopane worm' tasting challenge (with an official certificate for those brave enough to try!).
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text11: What should I wear to The Boma?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text12: Dress code is smart casual and comfortable. The dining area is thatched and partially open-air under the African night sky, so a light sweater or jacket is recommended during winter months (May to August).
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text13: How long does the evening last?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text14: The full experience lasts approximately 3 hours (6:45 PM to 10:00 PM), allowing ample time to savour all four courses, enjoy the live traditional dancers, participate in the interactive drumming, and relax with tea, coffee, or dessert.
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text15: Should I book The Boma in advance?
strings.travel/BomaExperiencePage.text16: Yes, advance reservations are strongly recommended. As Victoria Falls' flagship cultural dining experience, seats sell out quickly—especially during high safari season (July through October) and festive holiday periods.

strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text3: Walk out onto the famous 1905 steel Victoria Falls Railway Bridge spanning the Batoka Gorge. Positioned in the neutral 'No-Man's Land' between Zimbabwe and Zambia, you'll feel the rush of wind and catch your first glimpse of the roaring river 111 meters below.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text6: Meet your team of certified master riggers at the bridge jump station. You will be weighed, fitted with specialized padded ankle harnesses, and backed up with a heavy-duty climbing body harness for dual-redundant safety.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text9: Step onto the wooden jump gantry suspended directly over the abyss. With the spray of Mosi-oa-Tunya drifting past and the Zambezi rapids surging under your feet, the jump master guides you to the threshold.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text12: Leap forward into pure weightlessness! Experience 4 seconds of exhilarating freefall reaching terminal speeds over 120 km/h before the custom rubber bungee cord smoothly catches you in a series of gentle, soaring bounces.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text15: After the rebounds settle, a winch operator gently lowers a recovery line to hoist you smoothly back up to the bridge deck. Celebrate with fellow jumpers, receive your official Certificate of Bravery, and view your HD video footage.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text16: Is a visa required to go onto the Victoria Falls Bridge?
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text17: No! Border control at both the Zimbabwean and Zambian posts issue a complimentary Bridge Pass so you can step onto the bridge without using up a visa entry or paying border entry fees.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text18: How safe is the Victoria Falls Bungee Jump?
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text19: It is operated under strict British & Australian bungee standards with dual-redundant harness systems, daily cord inspections, and a 100% safety record across more than 500,000 jumps since 1994.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text20: Can non-jumping family and friends watch from the bridge?
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text21: Absolutely! Spectating from the bridge walkways or enjoying a cold beverage at the Bridge Café is completely free and provides an incredible vantage point for photos and videos.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text22: What are the age and weight requirements?
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text23: Minimum age is 14 years. Minimum weight requirement is 40 kg (88 lbs) and maximum weight is 140 kg (308 lbs). Parents or legal guardians must sign consent for jumpers under 18.
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text24: What should I wear for the bungee jump?
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text25: Wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe footwear like sneakers or running shoes. Loose objects, glasses, and pocket items must be secured or left in lockers at the jump office.

The sheer drop, the wind, and the mist create an adrenaline rush unmatched anywhere in Africa."
strings.travel/BungeeExperiencePage.text44: Spanning the canyon between two countries, the historic 1905 Victoria Falls Railway Bridge offers a leaping platform unlike any other on earth. As you stand on the jump gantry 111 meters above the churning white water of the Zambezi River, the roaring mist of Mosi-oa-Tunya forms giant rainbows across the basalt cliffs. It is equal parts awe-inspiring engineering, raw nature, and extreme bucket-list adventure.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Which area is best for first-time visitors?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: For a first visit, we usually recommend staying within 1 to 3 km of Victoria Falls town or rainforest park (such as Ilala Lodge or Batonka Guest Lodge). This gives you effortless access to rainforest walking paths, local restaurants, markets, and activity departures.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Should I stay close to town or outside town?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Staying close to town is ideal if you value walkability and dining flexibility. Staying slightly outside town or along the upper Zambezi River (like Victoria Falls Safari Lodge or Palm River Hotel) offers magnificent sunsets, river views, and wild game sightings, backed by complimentary shuttles.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Which properties are best for families?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Properties like Lokuthula Lodges offer 2 and 3-bedroom self-catering thatched units with kitchens and resort pools. Pioneers Victoria Falls and Batonka Guest Lodge also offer excellent interconnecting family rooms and relaxed, safe garden spaces.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Is a boutique lodge better than a hotel?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: It depends on your travel style. Boutique lodges (such as Batonka or Pioneers) offer intimate, quiet, highly personalized hosting with fewer guests. Hotels (like Ilala Lodge or The Victoria Falls Hotel) offer extensive on-site amenities, fine dining, and direct walking trails.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Which stays are best for honeymoons?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: The Palm River Hotel (riverfront luxury), The Victoria Falls Hotel (grand colonial romance), and Batonka Guest Lodge (private boutique peace) are exceptional choices for honeymooners.
We arrange seamless door-to-door private airport transfers in air-conditioned vehicles for all our guests upon booking.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Can Outbound Holidays recommend a property based on my budget?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Yes! Our interactive Accommodation Advisor above evaluates your travel style and budget to present 3 to 5 tailored options with transparent pros and trade-offs.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Can I combine a town stay with a safari lodge?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Absolutely. Many travellers enjoy spending 2 nights close to town for activities and 2 nights at a riverfront or game reserve safari lodge for wilderness relaxation.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: How far in advance should I book?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Peak season (May through October) fills up 6 to 9 months ahead for premier boutique lodges. We recommend securing your preferred stay early.

travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.q: Can I change the accommodation in a holiday package?
travel/AccommodationDirectoryPage.FAQS.a: Yes. All Outbound Holidays packages are fully customizable. You can swap any property to match your exact taste.

first-visit.title: First Visit Essentials
first-visit.metaTitle: First Time Visitor Experiences in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
first-visit.heroCopy: If this is your first time in Victoria Falls, start here. These are the experiences our local specialists recommend for understanding the destination, seeing its iconic sights and capturing signature moments.
first-visit.editorialIntro: Victoria Falls is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. For first-time visitors, structuring your itinerary around a guided rainforest tour, an iconic Zambezi sunset cruise, and a traditional cultural dinner guarantees you experience the true spirit of Mosi-oa-Tunya without feeling overwhelmed.

highlights.title: Rainforest Viewpoints
highlights.desc: Walk all 16 spectacular viewpoints along the Victoria Falls rainforest trail.

highlights.title: Zambezi Sunsets
highlights.desc: Experience golden hour on the upper river with wildlife and complimentary drinks.

highlights.title: Cultural Hospitality
highlights.desc: Enjoy authentic Zimbabwean dining and interactive djembe drumming.

highlights.title: Aerial Perspectives
highlights.desc: Optional Flight of Angels helicopter ride over the gorge and spray mist.

faqs.q: What is the best time of day to visit Victoria Falls rainforest?
faqs.a: Morning hours offer softer light, spectacular rainbows across the gorge, and cooler temperatures for walking.

faqs.q: Should I wear a raincoat for the guided tour?
faqs.a: During high-water season (March to July), raincoats and waterproof phone bags are essential due to heavy spray.

faqs.q: Can I combine these first-visit essentials into a 3-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes! Our 3-day First Timer package combines all these essential experiences seamlessly.

wildlife.title: Wildlife & Safari
wildlife.metaTitle: Wildlife Safaris & Game Drives in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
wildlife.heroCopy: Victoria Falls is surrounded by some of Southern Africa’s most rewarding wildlife destinations. From river safaris and game drives to full-day national park adventures.
wildlife.editorialIntro: Located at the meeting point of Zimbabwe, Botswana, Zambia, and Namibia, Victoria Falls offers effortless access to world-class game viewing. Track endangered black rhinos in Zambezi National Park or embark on a day safari to Chobe, guided by certified local trackers.

highlights.title: Big Five Opportunities
highlights.desc: Track elephant, lion, buffalo, leopard, and endangered rhinos.

highlights.title: Chobe Day Safaris
highlights.desc: Experience the world’s highest elephant density in nearby Botswana.

highlights.title: Zambezi River Safaris
highlights.desc: Up-close sightings of hippo pods, crocodiles, and diverse birdlife.

highlights.title: Rhino Tracking Safaris
highlights.desc: Guided walking safaris with armed rangers in private game reserves.

faqs.q: Are wildlife sightings guaranteed on game drives?
faqs.a: While wild animals move freely in their natural habitats, certified trackers have an extremely high success rate locating herds.

faqs.q: Is Chobe National Park far from Victoria Falls?
faqs.a: Chobe is just 70 km away across the Kazungula border, making it a comfortable 1-day safari excursion.

faqs.q: What should I bring on a safari drive?
faqs.a: Bring neutral-colored clothing, sun protection, binoculars, camera, and your passport for border crossings.

adventure.title: Adventure
adventure.metaTitle: Adventure & Adrenaline Experiences in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
adventure.heroCopy: Known as Africa’s adventure capital, Victoria Falls offers everything from bridge jumps and gorge swings to white-water rafting and high-speed river runs.
adventure.editorialIntro: The dramatic Batoka Gorge below Victoria Falls forms one of the world’s greatest natural adventure arenas. All extreme activities adhere to rigorous international safety standards, certified equipment inspections, and veteran jump masters.

highlights.title: 111m Bridge Bungee
highlights.desc: Jump into the Batoka Gorge from the historic Victoria Falls Bridge.

highlights.title: Class V Rafting
highlights.desc: Navigate world-famous rapids on the turbulent Zambezi River.

highlights.title: High-Wire Canopy
highlights.desc: Experience high-speed zip lines, flying fox, and tandem gorge swings.

highlights.title: Helicopter Flights
highlights.desc: Soar through the Batoka Gorge on the exhilarating Flight of Angels.

faqs.q: What safety certifications do adventure operators hold?
faqs.a: All operators are audited by international adventure safety bodies and hold comprehensive medical liability insurance.
Low water season (August to January) offers the most intense rapids, while high water season runs from February to July.

faqs.q: Can I do a bridge jump if I have no prior experience?
faqs.a: Yes! Full safety briefings are provided by master jump directors prior to every jump.

river.title: River Experiences
river.metaTitle: Zambezi River Cruises & Sunset Safaris in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
river.heroCopy: The Zambezi River offers a completely different side of Victoria Falls. Choose from relaxed sunset cruises, premium river journeys and unhurried moments on the water.
river.editorialIntro: Gliding along the upper Zambezi as the golden African sun sets behind palm-fringed islands is an essential Victoria Falls ritual. Whether on a luxury catamaran or a classic safari boat, river cruises combine tranquility with exceptional wildlife viewing.

highlights.title: Relaxed River Pace
highlights.desc: Navigate calm river channels surrounded by lush riverine forest.

highlights.title: Luxury Craft Options
highlights.desc: Gourmet tapas, open bar, and spacious observation decks.

highlights.title: Iconic Sunsets
highlights.desc: Unmatched golden-hour photographic light across the Zambezi.

highlights.title: Abundant River Wildlife
highlights.desc: Watch elephants swimming across islands and hippos surfacing.

faqs.q: What is included in a luxury Zambezi sunset cruise?
faqs.a: Cruises include return hotel transfers, premium open bar, chef-prepared appetizers, and guided wildlife commentary.

faqs.q: How long do sunset cruises last?
faqs.a: Standard cruises last approximately 2 to 2.5 hours on the water during sunset.

faqs.q: Are children allowed on sunset river cruises?
faqs.a: Yes! River cruises are calm, safe, and enjoyable for guests of all ages.

culture.title: Culture & Food
culture.metaTitle: Cultural & Culinary Experiences in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
culture.heroCopy: Go beyond sightseeing and connect with Victoria Falls through local food, live performances, traditional hospitality and cultural storytelling.
culture.editorialIntro: Zimbabwean hospitality is legendary for its warmth and vibrancy. From interactive djembe drumming and traditional Shangaan dancers to traditional village tours and craft markets, these experiences immerse you in local heritage.

highlights.title: Traditional Feast
highlights.desc: Sample spit-roasted game meats, local sadza, and traditional delicacies.

highlights.title: Interactive Drumming
highlights.desc: Join in live djembe drumming performances guided by master drummers.

highlights.title: Artisanal Craft Markets
highlights.desc: Discover hand-carved wooden sculptures, stone art, and woven crafts.

highlights.title: Authentic Heritage
highlights.desc: Learn about local customs, folklore, and historical traditions.

faqs.q: Is the Boma Dinner suitable for vegetarians?
faqs.a: Yes! The Boma features a massive buffet with extensive vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free selections.

faqs.q: Are hotel transfers included for dinner shows?
faqs.a: Yes, return hotel transfers are included with all Boma and cultural dinner bookings.

day-trips.title: Day Trips
day-trips.metaTitle: Day Excursions from Victoria Falls | Chobe & Hwange | Outbound Holidays
day-trips.heroCopy: Use Victoria Falls as your base for exploring nearby wildlife destinations, border towns and regional highlights that can be experienced in a single day.
day-trips.editorialIntro: Thanks to its central geographic location, Victoria Falls serves as the perfect springboard for day trips into Botswana’s Chobe National Park or Zimbabwe’s massive Hwange National Park, returning to your lodge by evening.

highlights.title: Chobe National Park
highlights.desc: Combine a river safari and land 4x4 drive in Botswana.

highlights.title: Hwange Game Drives
highlights.desc: Explore Zimbabwe’s premier elephant sanctuary on a day safari.

highlights.title: Cross-Border Efficiency
highlights.desc: Seamless border assistance handled by our professional transfer crew.

highlights.title: All-Inclusive Excursions
highlights.desc: Includes hotel pickup, park fees, guided safaris, and buffet lunch.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for the Chobe Day Trip to Botswana?
faqs.a: Many nationalities receive visa-free entry or a KAZA Univisa covering Zimbabwe and Zambia. Check passport requirements before travel.

faqs.q: What time does a Chobe Day Safari start and end?
faqs.a: Pickups begin around 07:00 AM with return transfers bringing you back to Victoria Falls by 17:30 PM.

wellness.title: Spa & Wellness
wellness.metaTitle: Luxury Safari Spa & Wellness in Victoria Falls | Outbound Holidays
wellness.heroCopy: Rejuvenate your senses after thrilling safari adventures with bespoke African botanical spa treatments, open-air bush massages, and tranquil hydrotherapy.
wellness.editorialIntro: Victoria Falls is the perfect sanctuary to unwind. Set within tranquil safari estate grounds overlooking wildlife waterholes and indigenous teak forests, our partnered wellness sanctuaries offer signature massages using marula and baobab oils.

highlights.title: African Botanical Therapies
highlights.desc: Indulge in treatments infused with organic marula, baobab, and melon seed oils.

highlights.title: Bushveld View Pavilions
highlights.desc: Relax in open-air treatment suites overlooking tranquil wildlife watering holes.

highlights.title: Hydrotherapy Pools
highlights.desc: Enjoy restorative plunge pools, herbal sauna suites, and tranquil sun decks.

highlights.title: Couples Sanctuary
highlights.desc: Private double massage pavilions with outdoor soaking tubs for partners.

faqs.q: Are hotel transfers included with spa bookings?
faqs.a: Yes, complimentary return road transfers from any Victoria Falls hotel or lodge are included with treatments over 60 minutes.

faqs.q: Can spa treatments be tailored for couples?
faqs.a: Yes, dedicated couples suites with dual massage beds and private baths are available upon request.

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: What time does The Boma start and end?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: The Boma evening begins at 6:45 PM with a ceremonial traditional welcome, hand washing, and village beer tasting. The interactive drumming show reaches its crescendo around 8:45 PM, followed by table acapella serenades and desserts. The evening concludes between 9:45 PM and 10:00 PM.

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: Is hotel transfer included in the experience?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: Round-trip hotel transfers are optional and can be easily bundled with your reservation. Our air-conditioned vehicles pick you up directly from your Victoria Falls hotel or safari lodge around 6:15 PM and return you safely after the show.

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: What food is served at the African buffet?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: The evening begins with a waiter-served starter platter including smoked crocodile tail, salted groundnuts with 'Nyimo' round nuts, and corn fritters. The main buffet features an open-fire braai with grilled game meats, beef, pork, chicken, and daily spit roast, plus traditional 'Umzingeli' hunter's potjie stews, Zambezi bream, Kapenta whitebait, peanut butter rice, and authentic sadza (isitshwala).

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: Are vegetarian and vegan options available?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: Yes! The Boma caters generously to vegetarian and plant-based diners with dedicated cooking stations preparing daily chef's pasta, vegetable stir-fries, bush vegetables, fresh soups, oven-baked garlic bread, and an extensive fresh salad bar including three-bean salad, sweet potato salad, potato salad, and beetroot salad.

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: Is The Boma family-friendly for children?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: Extremely family-friendly! Children of all ages love the vibrant energy, face painting, interactive drumming session where every guest gets their own Djembe drum, and the fun 'mopane worm' tasting challenge (with an official certificate for those brave enough to try!).

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: What should I wear to The Boma?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: Dress code is smart casual and comfortable. The dining area is thatched and partially open-air under the African night sky, so a light sweater or jacket is recommended during winter months (May to August).

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: How long does the evening last?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: The full experience lasts approximately 3 hours (6:45 PM to 10:00 PM), allowing ample time to savour all four courses, enjoy the live traditional dancers, participate in the interactive drumming, and relax with tea, coffee, or dessert.

travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.q: Should I book The Boma in advance?
travel/BomaExperiencePage.section1.a: Yes, advance reservations are strongly recommended. As Victoria Falls' flagship cultural dining experience, seats sell out quickly—especially during high safari season (July through October) and festive holiday periods.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.title: The Historic Bridge Approach
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.description: Walk out onto the famous 1905 steel Victoria Falls Railway Bridge spanning the Batoka Gorge. Positioned in the neutral 'No-Man's Land' between Zimbabwe and Zambia, you'll feel the rush of wind and catch your first glimpse of the roaring river 111 meters below.
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.highlight: Free bridge pass provided at border control—no visa needed!

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.title: Safety Briefing & Precision Harnessing
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.description: Meet your team of certified master riggers at the bridge jump station. You will be weighed, fitted with specialized padded ankle harnesses, and backed up with a heavy-duty climbing body harness for dual-redundant safety.
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.highlight: Operated with a 100% safety record over 500,000+ jumps.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.title: The Edge Walk & Gantry Launchpad
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.description: Step onto the wooden jump gantry suspended directly over the abyss. With the spray of Mosi-oa-Tunya drifting past and the Zambezi rapids surging under your feet, the jump master guides you to the threshold.
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.highlight: Breathtaking 360° panoramic view of Batoka Canyon.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.title: 5... 4... 3... 2... 1... BUNGEE!
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.description: Leap forward into pure weightlessness! Experience 4 seconds of exhilarating freefall reaching terminal speeds over 120 km/h before the custom rubber bungee cord smoothly catches you in a series of gentle, soaring bounces.
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.highlight: 4 seconds of sheer vertical zero-gravity freefall.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.title: Winch Recovery & Certificate of Bravery
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.description: After the rebounds settle, a winch operator gently lowers a recovery line to hoist you smoothly back up to the bridge deck. Celebrate with fellow jumpers, receive your official Certificate of Bravery, and view your HD video footage.
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section1.highlight: Official Certificate of Bravery & HD video memories.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.q: Is a visa required to go onto the Victoria Falls Bridge?
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.a: No! Border control at both the Zimbabwean and Zambian posts issue a complimentary Bridge Pass so you can step onto the bridge without using up a visa entry or paying border entry fees.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.q: How safe is the Victoria Falls Bungee Jump?
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.a: It is operated under strict British & Australian bungee standards with dual-redundant harness systems, daily cord inspections, and a 100% safety record across more than 500,000 jumps since 1994.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.q: Can non-jumping family and friends watch from the bridge?
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.a: Absolutely! Spectating from the bridge walkways or enjoying a cold beverage at the Bridge Café is completely free and provides an incredible vantage point for photos and videos.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.q: What are the age and weight requirements?
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.a: Minimum age is 14 years. Minimum weight requirement is 40 kg (88 lbs) and maximum weight is 140 kg (308 lbs). Parents or legal guardians must sign consent for jumpers under 18.

travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.q: What should I wear for the bungee jump?
travel/BungeeExperiencePage.section2.a: Wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe footwear like sneakers or running shoes. Loose objects, glasses, and pocket items must be secured or left in lockers at the jump office.

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section1.desc: Watch hippos & elephants with complimentary sundowners.

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section2.desc: 4x4 tracking of lion, leopard, buffalo, and elephant.

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section2.title: Rhino Tracking Drive in Victoria Falls
travel/ExperienceExplorer.section2.desc: Walk with endangered white rhinos accompanied by armed rangers.

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section2.title: Chobe River Safari Cruise

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section2.title: Hwange National Park Day Safari

travel/ExperienceExplorer.section3.whyWeRecommend: A bucket-list experience available strictly during low-water months under strict expert supervision.

travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.q: Which experiences should a first-time visitor prioritise?
travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.a: For first-time visitors, we strongly recommend starting with a Guided Tour of Victoria Falls rainforest, an Upper Zambezi Sunset Cruise, and the iconic Boma Dinner Experience. If time allows, adding the Flight of Angels helicopter tour provides an extraordinary aerial perspective.

travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.q: How far in advance should I book activities?
travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.a: We recommend booking popular experiences—such as helicopter flights, sunset cruises, and Chobe day safaris—at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance during peak season (June to October) to guarantee preferred time slots.

travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.q: Can experiences be combined into one itinerary?
travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.a: Absolutely! Most activities can be seamlessly scheduled across 2 to 4 days. Our local specialists ensure ideal timing so you enjoy relaxed transitions between morning tours, afternoon safaris, and evening dining.
Yes, almost all guided experiences in Victoria Falls town include return hotel transfers from major lodges and hotels.

Many activities—including rainforest tours, sunset cruises, cultural Boma dinners, and family safaris—are fantastic for all ages. Age restrictions apply only to extreme adrenaline adventures like bungee jumping or white-water rafting.

Activity costs cover guided services and transport, while government park entry fees ($50 international per person for rainforest entry) are paid directly at park gates unless specified in your custom package.

travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.q: Can Outbound Holidays recommend experiences based on my budget?
travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.a: Yes! Our local advisors design custom experience bundles tailored precisely to your budget, travel dates, and preferred pace.

travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.q: What happens if weather affects an activity?
travel/ExperiencesDirectoryPage.section2.a: Your safety is our priority. If an activity like a helicopter flight is postponed due to weather, we will rebook it for another time during your stay or issue a full refund.

travel/FaqSection.section1.q: How much should I budget for a Victoria Falls trip?
travel/FaqSection.section1.a: Trips typically start from $350 per person for smart budget stays up to $2,150+ for luxury all-inclusive riverfront lodges. Packages usually include accommodation, transfers, guided rainforest tours, and sunset cruises. We tailor every itinerary to match your exact budget.

travel/FaqSection.section1.q: Can I pay a deposit to secure my booking?
travel/FaqSection.section1.a: Yes! You can secure your lodge dates and activity reservations with a small deposit (typically 20% - 30%), and pay the remaining balance closer to your arrival date. We offer flexible payment arrangements.

travel/FaqSection.section1.q: Is the initial planning consultation free?
travel/FaqSection.section1.a: 100% free with zero obligation to book! You can speak or chat with our Victoria Falls travel specialists, receive itemized quote options, and ask as many questions as you need without paying anything.

travel/FaqSection.section1.q: Can you plan around my specific budget or custom dates?
travel/FaqSection.section1.a: Absolutely. Whether you have 2 days or 2 weeks, a tight budget or an unrestricted luxury vision, our local team builds custom itineraries from scratch specifically for your dates and party size.

travel/FaqSection.section1.q: How quickly will I receive my custom quotation?
travel/FaqSection.section1.a: Once you submit your details via our 3-minute Holiday Builder or WhatsApp, a Victoria Falls specialist will review your preferences and send an itemized quotation within 2 to 4 hours during office hours.
